newsitem.title: USA: HEI Q2 margin seen as typical for FY97.
newsitem.headline: HEI Q2 margin seen as typical for FY97.

text.p: HEI Inc said Thursday the transition to volume pricing and lower margin rates continued in the second quarter and is typical of what may be expected for the balance of fiscal 1997.

"The lower margin rate experienced in the second quarter is more typical of what we may expect throughout the remainder of fiscal 1997, assuming the program continues at current volumes," said Jerald Mortenson, vice president of finance.
Mortenson, in a statement, attributed HEI's higher sales for the second quarter, ended March 1, to continuation of the ramp-up to volume production of a device for use in high-density disk drives.
"We continue to pursue various new opportunities in telecommunications, medical and computer peripheral applications," Mortenson added.

HEI, which designs and manufactures ultraminiature microelectronic devices, reported higher second-quarter sales and earnings. It said the transition to volume pricing and lower margin rates began late in the first quarter.
